rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who calmly accepts disappointment or hardship without dwelling on it.

example.english: The report did not win an award, but he was philosophical and said he would try harder next time.
example.traditional: 份報告冇獲獎，佢都睇得開，仲話下次再努力。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 mou5 wok6 zoeng2 keoi5 dou1 tai2 dak1 hoi1 zung6 waa6 haa6 ci3 zoi3 nou5 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on staying calm and composed rather than on accepting things philosophically.

example.english: Even when the computer suddenly crashed, they stayed philosophical.
example.traditional: 就算部電腦突然死機，佢都仲係好淡定。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 bou6 din6 nou5 dat6 jin4 sei2 gei1 keoi5 dou1 zung6 hai6 hou2 daam6 ding6

rows.note: Use this for a person whose thinking is analytical, reflective, and philosophical.

example.english: They are philosophical and always ask about the reasons behind things.
example.traditional: 佢有哲學頭腦，成日追問事情背後嘅原因。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 zit3 hok6 tau4 nou5 seng4 jat6 zeoi1 man6 si6 cing4 bui3 hau6 ge3 jyun4 jan1
